name: omnibar-shortcuts
description: MV3 omnibar shortcut engine for Chrome and Firefox

scripts.copy-files: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp popup.html dist/ && cp -r icons dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:firefox: tsc && cp manifest.firefox.json dist/manifest.json && cp popup.html dist/ && cp -r icons dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
